basic_info.description: Step into this bright and airy 1920s home, a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of San Francisco city life. This tranquil retreat features three spacious bedrooms and one bathroom on the main level, which overlooks the quiet, sunny back yard. Bay windows flood the living spaces with natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere throughout. Host unforgettable dinner parties in the formal dining room, or cozy up in the living room by the warmth of a wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting stainless steel appliances and quartz counter tops. With stunning hardwood flooring throughout, the home perfectly balances classic elegance with modern living. Be sure to check out the impressive high ceilings on the ground floor, where you'll discover several bonus rooms offering plentiful storage and expansion potential.
